summary.vi: So sánh hơn dùng để nói một người hoặc vật có mức độ cao hơn (hoặc thấp hơn) so với người hoặc vật khác.
summary.en: The comparative is used to say that one person or thing has a higher (or lower) degree of a quality than another.

when_to_use.vi: Khi so sánh hai người, hai vật hoặc hai tình huống với nhau.
when_to_use.en: When you compare two people, two things, or two situations with each other.

when_to_use.vi: Khi muốn nói một thứ tốt hơn, nhanh hơn, đắt hơn, thú vị hơn, v.v. so với thứ khác.
when_to_use.en: When you want to say one thing is better, faster, more expensive, more interesting, etc. than another.

when_to_use.vi: Khi câu trả lời cần nêu rõ mốc so sánh, thường bắt đầu bằng “than”.
when_to_use.en: When the answer needs to name the point of comparison, usually introduced by “than”.

examples.text: My bike is faster than yours.

annotation.vi: “faster” là dạng so sánh hơn của “fast”; “than yours” nêu mốc so sánh.
annotation.en: “faster” is the comparative form of “fast”; “than yours” gives the point of comparison.

translation.vi: Xe đạp của tôi nhanh hơn xe của bạn.
translation.en: My bike is faster than yours.

examples.text: This lesson is more interesting than the last one.

annotation.vi: Tính từ dài “interesting” dùng “more” thay vì thêm -er.
annotation.en: The long adjective “interesting” uses “more” instead of -er.

translation.vi: Bài học này thú vị hơn bài trước.
translation.en: This lesson is more interesting than the last one.

annotation.vi: “hotter” gấp đôi phụ âm cuối trước khi thêm -er.
annotation.en: “hotter” doubles the final consonant before adding -er.

translation.vi: Hôm nay nóng hơn hôm qua.

compare.this_example: My bike is faster than yours.
compare.other_example: My bike is as fast as yours.

this_meaning.vi: So sánh hơn nói mức độ khác nhau: một bên hơn bên kia.
this_meaning.en: The comparative says the degrees are different: one side is more than the other.

other_meaning.vi: So sánh bằng nói hai bên ngang nhau, không bên nào hơn.
other_meaning.en: The as...as pattern says the two sides are equal, with no difference.

compare.this_example: This restaurant is better than that one.
compare.other_example: This restaurant is the best in town.

this_meaning.vi: So sánh hơn so hai người/vật với nhau.
this_meaning.en: The comparative compares two people or things with each other.

other_meaning.vi: So sánh nhất so một người/vật với cả nhóm, nêu mức cao nhất.
other_meaning.en: The superlative compares one person or thing with the whole group and names the highest degree.

reason.vi: “faster” đã là dạng so sánh hơn, nên không dùng thêm “more”.
reason.en: “faster” is already a comparative form, so “more” cannot be added.

reason.vi: Tính từ dài như “difficult” tạo so sánh hơn bằng “more”, không thêm -er.
reason.en: Long adjectives like “difficult” form the comparative with “more”, not with -er.

explain.vi: “tall” là tính từ ngắn, dạng so sánh hơn là “taller”.
explain.en: “tall” is a short adjective, so its comparative form is “taller”.

quick_practice.q: This book is ___ than that one.

explain.vi: “interesting” là tính từ dài, dùng “more interesting”.
explain.en: “interesting” is a long adjective, so we use “more interesting”.

quick_practice.q: The weather today is ___ than yesterday.

explain.vi: “bad” có dạng so sánh hơn bất quy tắc là “worse”.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu so sánh hơn về hai người hoặc hai vật quanh bạn.
prompt.en: Write one comparative sentence about two people or things around you.

sample.text: My phone is newer than yours.

corrections.issue: R5's example 'This car is more faster.' is given as a mistake, but the corrected version 'This car is faster.' is fine; however, R5's rule list does not mention the irregular forms 'better/worse' in the formula, only in exceptions.
corrections.fix: Added irregular forms to the formula options and to the quick practice, and kept the double comparative as a common mistake.

corrections.issue: R5's example 'Math is difficulter.' is a mistake, but the explanation says 'difficult dùng more' without showing the full corrected sentence with 'than'.
corrections.fix: Wrote the corrected sentence as 'Math is more difficult.' and explained that long adjectives use 'more'.

corrections.issue: R5's guided practice includes 'more ___ than (interesting)' with answer 'more interesting than', which is not a full sentence and mixes the blank with the marker.
corrections.fix: Replaced with a full cloze sentence in quick_practice: 'This book is ___ than that one.' with options 'more interesting' and 'interestinger'.
